decision: Fairly choose the generator configuration for the later PM research using ESC-Eval as the external benchmark, without presenting an adapted in-house judge as the benchmark itself.

official_anchor.paper: Zhao et al., ESC-Eval, EMNLP 2024 main conference
official_anchor.interaction: ESC-Role and the model under evaluation conduct a five-turn dialogue at temperature 0.
official_anchor.paper_primary_evaluation: Human annotators score the seven dimensions; ESC-RANK is trained as an automated scorer from those annotations.

protocol_repair_boundary.name: ESC-Eval English research-aligned protocol repair
why_not_exact: The public evaluate.py applies a generic helpful-assistant system message and asymmetric 256/512 output caps across example model wrappers.
The public scorer has path, base-revision, parser, and role-marker defects documented in the V3 qualification audit.
The intended research generator must receive the same prior-work-grounded emotional-support prompt in every PM and baseline arm.
retained_official_elements: official seven evaluation dimensions and 0-to-4 behavioral anchors
uniform_repairs: one identical research-aligned supporter prompt for every candidate
no researcher output-token cap for any candidate
same role-player revision and common seed by card and turn position
strict and anchored scorer parsing reported separately
all deviations named in the paper; no claim of exact official leaderboard reproduction

development_selection.surface: 24 previously frozen English high-quality ESC-Eval development cards spanning MHP, EPITOME, ExTES, ESConv, and Psych
development_selection.official_esc_rank_result: Completed 651 local dimension inferences including descriptive Nemotron subset. Strict format validity was 0/651; anchored sensitivity was valid but heavily saturated, so ESC-RANK remains descriptive and cannot select the generator.
development_selection.next_measurement: The two independent blinded review packets are materialized. Human A and Human B must now score all 72 reliability-eligible complete dialogues on the official seven 0-to-4 dimensions; each sees one dialogue at a time and a different order, with candidate/model/provider/card/source identity absent.
development_selection.statistical_unit: ESC-Eval role card/dialogue; seven dimensions and five turns are repeated measures.
development_selection.adjudication: Any dimension disagreement of at least 2 points, any invalid transcript flag, and any explicit integrity concern receives a third blinded adjudication.

metric_and_decision_hierarchy.selection_rule: Retain hard-gate passers. A unique development winner requires noninferiority on the registered Overall, Empathy, Skill, and Information margins, strict superiority on Overall or at least two key dimensions, and no project-guardrail regression. If configurations are human-rated equivalent, choose the least costly/fastest. If dimensions materially trade off, retain the Pareto set and do not invent one winner.

prompt_freeze.candidate_symmetry: The exact same system prompt is used for Llama, Qwen non-thinking, Qwen thinking, every later PM arm, and every baseline arm.
boundaries: no exposed strategy label or chain of thought
no PM head or memory fact on the base-capability surface
not an exact official zero-shot wrapper reproduction

confirmation_after_development.surface: All 331 official English high-quality ESC-Eval cards, or an explicitly named frozen stratified English subset if full execution is infeasible; never call a subset the full benchmark.
confirmation_after_development.candidates: Development winner and strongest non-dominated challenger under the predeclared rule.
evaluation: complete five-turn generation with the same repaired protocol
seven-dimension ESC-RANK descriptive profile with parser limitations
two-human official seven-dimension scoring on a source/category-stratified confirmation subset frozen before generation outcomes
objective reliability, token, USD, and latency reporting
confirmation_after_development.before_formal_pm: The generator configuration and prompt are then frozen identically for every PM and baseline arm.

role_of_other_evaluators.esc_judge_eia: Optional sensitivity analysis only; cannot replace ESC-Eval seven-dimensional primary evaluation.
role_of_other_evaluators.custom_llm_quality: Development diagnostics only unless independently human-qualified; cannot be described as a public benchmark.
role_of_other_evaluators.atomic_risk: Required project integrity guardrail, not part of the ESC-Eval official score and not full clinical safety.

claim_boundary.development_24: Supports only a development-screen generator choice on a named ESC-Eval English subset.
claim_boundary.english_331: Can support a repaired-protocol ESC-Eval English qualification, not an exact official leaderboard reproduction.
not_supported: Chinese performance without the 324 Chinese cards
model-weight superiority independent of hosted route

authorization: Zero-call correction and human-packet design only. No generator, judge, scorer, or human-review consumption is authorized by this file.
